PS C:\Users\Lenovo> # 2. RUN ROBOCOPY BYPASS ENGINE (No Long-Path Node Errors)
PS C:\Users\Lenovo> # ==============================================================================
PS C:\Users\Lenovo> foreach ($folder in $localFolders) {
>>     if (Test-Path $folder) {
>>         $folderName = Split-Path $folder -Leaf
>>         $targetPath = "$stagingDir\$folderName"
>>         Write-Host "Safely mirroring deep paths for: $folderName..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
>>
>>         # Native Windows Robocopy handles long nested runtime snapshot environments perfectly
>>         robocopy $folder $targetPath /E /R:0 /W:0 /NDL /NFL /NJH /NJS
>>     } else {
>>         Write-Warning "Target directory source not found, skipping: $folder"
>>     }
>> }
